heading: Requirement for efficient use by intelligence community of open-source intelligence
lead: The Director of National Intelligence shall ensure that the intelligence community makes efficient and effective use of open-source information and analysis.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified as a note under section 403–1 of this title prior to editorial reclassification as this section.

notes.heading: Assessing Intelligence Community Open-Source Support for Export Controls and Foreign Investment Screening
notes.text: Pub. L. 117–263, div.
